questions.q_en: 9 men can finish a job in 20 days. After 8 days, 3 men leave. How many additional days are needed to complete the project?
questions.solution_en:
Let the total work be 9 men X 20 days = 180 man-days.

Work done in 8 days = 9 X 8 = 72 man-days.

Remaining work = 180 - 72 = 108 man-days.

Remaining men = 9 - 3 = 6.

Time needed = 108 / 6 = 18 days.
questions.solution_hi:

Time needed = 108 / 6 = 18 days.

questions.q_en: Two sides of a triangular field are 25 meters and 17 meters respectively and its perimeter is 54 meters. Find the area of the field.
questions.solution_en:
Perimeter =sum of 3 sides of the field.

So third side of the triangle field= 54-(25+17) =12 meter

S =(25+17+12)/2=27

Area of the triangle field =square root of (27*(27-25)*(27-17)(27-12))

Area = square root of (27*2*10*15)

Hence Area of the triangle field =90 square meter

questions.q_en: In the figure given below, ABC is a triangle. BC is parallel to AE. If BC = AC, then what is the value of 2∠CAE?
questions.solution_en:
"

Given,

BC || AE

∠CBA + ∠EAB = 180°

∠EAB=180 - 65 = 115 °

∵ BC = AC

Hence ∆ABC is an isosceles triangle;

∠CBA = ∠CAB = 65°

Now,

∠EAB = ∠EAC + ∠CAB

⇒ 115 ° = x + 65 ° = 2x = 100 °"

questions.q_en: A drone hovers at the top of a 180-meter-high cliff, scanning a nearby tower. The angles of depression from the drone to the base and the top of the tower are 60° and 30° respectively. Calculate the height of the tower.
questions.solution_en:
In triangle ABC,

tan60° = 180/x

x = 180/√3 m

x = 60√3 m

In triangle ADE,

tan30° = (180 - H)/x

1/√3 = (180 - H)/x

1/√3 = (180 - H)/ (60√3)

60 = 180 - H

H = 120 m.

questions.q_en: Average runs scored by a batsman in his first 9 matches is 40. How many runs he must score in his 10th match so that his average increases by 2.4 runs?

Total runs in first 9 matches = 40 * 9 = 360 runs

Total runs in all 10 matches = 42.4 * 10 = 424 runs

Runs scored in 10th match = 424 - 360

= 64 runs

questions.q_en: Two pipes P and Q can fill a tank in 52 minutes and 156 minutes, respectively. If pipe P is opened at 7:30 am and pipe Q is opened at 8:00 am, then the tank will be filled in how much time (in minutes)?
questions.solution_en:
Two pipes P and Q can fill a tank in 52 minutes and 156 minutes, respectively.

Part of tank is filled by P in 30 minutes = 30/52 = 15/26

So, remaining part = 1 - 15/26 = 11/26

So, 11/26 part of tank filled by P and Q together in = 11/26 * 1/(1/52 + 1/156) = 11/26 * 39 = 16.5 minutes

So, time = 30 + 16.5 = 46.5 minutes
